page.overview:
Who is Viria Connoral?

Viria has dark hair that is braided and coiled atop her head. It is unknown whether she and Raechin are identical twins.

Nothing is known about Viria's strength and abilities in the One Power.

She has a sister, Raechin Connoral, who is also a Sitter for the Red. With the deaths of Vandene and Adeleas Namelle, they are the sole remaining siblings in the White Tower. Being a Sitter in the Hall means that Viria has been Aes Sedai for, at least, more than one hundred years.

Viria became a Sitter in the Hall of the Tower after the White Tower Schism was mended. Egwene al'Vere considers her an odd choice for the position, but not unexpected.
